def attr_attributes_transform(node: ClassDef) -> None:
    """Given that the ClassNode has an attr decorator,
    rewrite class attributes as instance attributes
    """
    # Astroid can't infer this attribute properly
    # Prevents https://github.com/pylint-dev/pylint/issues/1884
    node.locals["__attrs_attrs__"] = [Unknown(parent=node)]

    # Check if this class is decorated with a new style attrs decorator
    is_new_style = is_decorated_with_new_style_attrs(node)

    for cdef_body_node in node.body:
        if not isinstance(cdef_body_node, (Assign, AnnAssign)):
            continue
            
        # Handle attributes defined with attr.ib() or similar
        if isinstance(cdef_body_node.value, Call):
            if cdef_body_node.value.func.as_string() not in ATTRIB_NAMES:
                # For new style decorators, also handle bare annotations with default values
                # that aren't attr.ib() calls
                if not (is_new_style and isinstance(cdef_body_node, AnnAssign)):
                    continue
            # For traditional attr.ib() style attributes, process them
            targets = (
                cdef_body_node.targets
                if hasattr(cdef_body_node, "targets")
                else [cdef_body_node.target]
            )
            for target in targets:
                rhs_node = Unknown(
                    lineno=cdef_body_node.lineno,
                    col_offset=cdef_body_node.col_offset,
                    parent=cdef_body_node,
                )
                if isinstance(target, AssignName):
                    # Could be a subscript if the code analysed is
                    # i = Optional[str] = ""
                    # See https://github.com/pylint-dev/pylint/issues/4439
                    node.locals[target.name] = [rhs_node]
                    node.instance_attrs[target.name] = [rhs_node]
        # Handle bare annotations for new style decorators
        elif is_new_style and isinstance(cdef_body_node, AnnAssign):
            # This is a bare annotation like 'bar: int' or 'baz: str = "hello"'
            target = cdef_body_node.target
            rhs_node = Unknown(
                lineno=cdef_body_node.lineno,
                col_offset=cdef_body_node.col_offset,
                parent=cdef_body_node,
            )
            if isinstance(target, AssignName):
                node.locals[target.name] = [rhs_node]
                node.instance_attrs[target.name] = [rhs_node]
